title: Canadian scientists in the legacy program
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Canadian scientists in the legacy program, about ongoing at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because Canadian scientists have been and are involved in the legacy program.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist who covers UFO claims, says that Canadian scientists have worked, and still work, in what he calls the legacy program, said to be a secret effort to recover and study craft not made by humans. If true, that effort would reach beyond the United States.
